name: Apollo
description: Apollo lets agents search B2B contacts and companies, enrich records, and review sequences in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Apollo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find VPs of engineering at fintech companies in London.
Enrich this list of companies with size, industry, and location.
Which of my sequences had the best reply rate this month?

apps.name: Apollo
apps.description: Contact search, enrichment, and sequences, over Apollo's MCP server with browser sign-in.
